July 3, 1985 - Right. Time to take Kolgujev. That's Russian territory - so God only knows what kind of international laws we're about to violate. But after what we've gone through on Everon and Malden, that really doesn't seem important right now.

We've got to stop Guba, at all costs.

Hide out in the woods and await further orders.

Moscow's getting edgy, Commander Gastovski, so Washington wants this thing finished before the entire Red Army piles in. Uncle Sam's sending everything he's got into Kolgujev to nail Guba once and for all.

So after your recon operation, it's time to go back in and fire NATO's first ever shots in anger on Warsaw Pact territory. Those Shilka sites have got to be neutralized just ahead of NATO's combined ground and air assault, which begins at dawn - that's in three hours.

Your team will land on the the beach on the southern edge of the island. The Shilka sites you've already located will be marked on your map.
